definition: a set of steps between two floors
description: On a sunny day, a young man in a tuxedo and bow tie walks carefully down a long outdoor stone staircase between old houses, holding a tall three-tier white wedding cake on a silver tray high above his head while rose petals fall around him. Step by step he comes closer. Wedding guests cheer from a balcony at the top, a woman leans on a side balcony with a cloth hanging over the railing, and older neighbours sit on chairs by the steps next to pots of red geraniums.

en.question: What is the young man descending?

de.question: Was steigt der junge Mann hinab?

es.answer: Está bajando un tramo de escalones de piedra.
es.question: ¿Qué está bajando el joven?

fr.answer: Il descend une volée de marches en pierre.
phrases: crier de joie depuis le balcon
fr.question: Que descend le jeune homme ?
